en_us: Forty-eight trinkets nobody crafts: find them, wear them, stack their effects.
es_es: Cuarenta y ocho chucherías que nadie fabrica: encontralas, ponételas y sumá sus efectos.

hover.en_us: Back to the Sun of Heliodor

en_us.title: Amateur Archaeologist
en_us.subtitle: Nobody crafts these. Somebody lost them.
text: [lead] Artifacts are never crafted.
[li] They wait in structure chests, in suspicious sand and gravel, in underground campsites and on the odd mob.
[li] Pick one up and it goes in a Curios slot ([key:key.curios.open.desc]).
{page}
The slots: one head, one necklace, one belt, two hands and one feet slot, the last one added by Artifacts itself.
Each has a cosmetic twin.

es_es.title: Arqueólogo aficionado
es_es.subtitle: Nadie las fabrica. Alguien las perdió.
text: [lead] Los artefactos nunca se fabrican.
[li] Esperan en cofres de estructuras, en arena y grava sospechosas, en campamentos bajo tierra y encima de algún mob.
[li] Agarrá uno y va a una ranura de Curios ([key:key.curios.open.desc]).
{page}
Las ranuras: una de cabeza, una de collar, una de cinturón, dos de manos y una de pies, que agrega el propio Artifacts.
Cada una tiene su gemela cosmética.

en_us.title: Where the odds are best
text: [tip] Where a chest rolls an artifact, and how often:
[li] Bastion treasure rooms: [hl|65%]
[li] Big underwater ruins: [hl|45%]
[li] Woodland mansions: [hl|40%]
[li] Jungle temples: [hl|35%]
[li] Mineshafts, stronghold corridors, igloos and End cities: [hl|30%]
[li] The other chests: between [hl|5] and [hl|25%]
{page}
[tip] Lootr gives every player their own roll of each chest, so the whole team gets a try.

es_es.title: Dónde conviene buscar
text: [tip] Dónde tira un cofre un artefacto, y con qué frecuencia:
[li] Tesoros de bastión: [hl|65%]
[li] Ruinas submarinas grandes: [hl|45%]
[li] Mansiones del bosque: [hl|40%]
[li] Templos de la jungla: [hl|35%]
[li] Minas, pasillos de fortaleza, iglúes y ciudades del End: [hl|30%]
[li] El resto de los cofres: entre [hl|5] y [hl|25%]
{page}
[tip] Lootr le da a cada jugador su propia tirada de cada cofre: todo el equipo tiene su chance.

en_us.title: Brush, don't dig
en_us.subtitle: Archaeology, but for trinkets.
text: [lead] One suspicious block in sixteen hides an artifact.
It replaces the block's usual find, in:
[li] Desert wells and pyramids
[li] Ocean ruins
[li] Trail ruins
Work it with a [item:minecraft:brush|Brush]: a pickaxe only breaks it.

es_es.title: Cepillá, no caves
es_es.subtitle: Arqueología, pero de chucherías.
text: [lead] Uno de cada dieciséis bloques sospechosos esconde un artefacto.
Reemplaza el hallazgo de siempre del bloque, en:
[li] Pozos y pirámides del desierto
[li] Ruinas oceánicas
[li] Ruinas de senderos
Trabajalo con un [item:minecraft:brush|Pincel]: con el pico sólo se rompe.

en_us.title: Chest Slayer
en_us.subtitle: If the chest has teeth, it has loot.
text: [lead] Some underground campsites keep a chest that bites.
Camps with a bed, a workbench, a furnace and supply barrels turn up between Y -[hl|60] and [hl|40], and three in ten swap their chest for a [name:entity.artifacts.mimic].
Open it and it bites: [hl|60] health, [hl|5] damage a hit, and an artifact every time it dies.
{page}
[tip] While it sits on the ground, arrows bounce off it: catch it mid-jump or go in close.
Too slow? [quest:hnn_model_mimic|A simulated Mimic] picks the artifact for you.

es_es.title: Asesino de cofres
es_es.subtitle: Si el cofre tiene dientes, tiene botín.
text: [lead] Algunos campamentos subterráneos guardan un cofre que muerde.
Los campamentos con cama, mesa de trabajo, horno y barriles de provisiones aparecen entre Y -[hl|60] y [hl|40], y tres de cada diez cambian su cofre por un [name:entity.artifacts.mimic].
Abrilo y muerde: [hl|60] de vida, [hl|5] de daño por golpe y un artefacto cada vez que muere.
{page}
[tip] Mientras está en el piso, las flechas le rebotan: agarralo en pleno salto o andá cuerpo a cuerpo.
¿Muy lento? [quest:hnn_model_mimic|Un Mímic simulado] elige el artefacto por vos.

sources: jar:artifacts-neoforge-13.2.3.jar:artifacts/world/CampsiteFeature.class#barrels with the campsite_barrel loot table, campfires
jar:artifacts-neoforge-13.2.3.jar:artifacts/entity/MimicEntity.class#createMobAttributes: MAX_HEALTH 60, ATTACK_DAMAGE 5; hurt: grounded mimic ignores IS_PROJECTILE

en_us.title: Mobs dressed for the part
en_us.subtitle: Yes, that zombie was invisible on purpose.
text: [lead] About one zombie, skeleton or piglin in [hl|670] spawns already wearing an artifact, and drops it when it dies.

Drowned go for [item:artifacts:snorkel|Snorkels] and [item:artifacts:flippers|Flippers], strays for [item:artifacts:snowshoes|Snowshoes], ghasts for hats, and the odd zombie for a [item:artifacts:scarf_of_invisibility|Scarf of Invisibility].

es_es.title: Mobs bien vestidos
es_es.subtitle: Sí, ese zombi era invisible a propósito.
text: [lead] Más o menos uno de cada [hl|670] zombis, esqueletos o piglins aparece con un artefacto puesto, y lo suelta al morir.

Los ahogados eligen [item:artifacts:snorkel|Gafas de Buceo] y [item:artifacts:flippers|Aletas], los errantes [item:artifacts:snowshoes|Botas de Nieve], los ghasts sombreros y algún zombi una [item:artifacts:scarf_of_invisibility|Bufanda de la Invisibilidad].

en_us.title: The steak that never ends
text: [lead] A steak that never runs out, if you find the right beef.
Cows and mooshrooms a player kills drop an [item:artifacts:everlasting_beef|Everlasting Beef] one time in [hl|500], and butcher chests and bastion stables hide it too.
Cook it into an [item:artifacts:eternal_steak|Eternal Steak]: it's never used up, it only waits [hl|15] seconds between bites.
{page}
[tip] Spice of Life pays a heart at [hl|10], [hl|25], [hl|45], [hl|70] and [hl|100] different foods, so the same steak forever earns none: keep it as a safety net.

es_es.title: El filete que no se termina
text: [lead] Un filete que no se acaba, si encontrás la carne justa.

Las vacas y los mooshrooms que mata un jugador sueltan un [item:artifacts:everlasting_beef|Filete Crudo Eterno] una de cada [hl|500] veces, y también aparece en cofres de carnicero y establos de bastión.
Cocinalo y tenés un [item:artifacts:eternal_steak|Filete Eterno]: nunca se gasta, sólo espera [hl|15] segundos entre bocado y bocado.
{page}
[tip] Spice of Life da un corazón a las [hl|10], [hl|25], [hl|45], [hl|70] y [hl|100] comidas distintas, así que el mismo filete para siempre no suma ninguno: guardalo como red de seguridad.

en_us.title: Duplicates for the common store
en_us.subtitle: The third Villager Hat helps nobody.
text: [lead] Any two artifacts you won't wear for the common store, once a day.
Between mimics and chests, copies pile up fast.
[note] Submit takes the first matching items, hotbar first. The Eternal Steak, Everlasting Beef, Umbrella, Chorus Totem and Crystal Heart are not accepted.

es_es.title: Repetidos para el depósito común
es_es.subtitle: El tercer Sombrero de Paja no le sirve a nadie.
text: [lead] Dos artefactos que no vas a usar para el depósito común, una vez por día.
Entre mímics y cofres, los repetidos se juntan rápido.
[note] Entregar toma los primeros ítems que coinciden, empezando por la barra. No se aceptan el Filete Eterno, el Filete Crudo Eterno, el Paraguas, el Tótem de Coral ni el Corazón de Cristal.

sources: jar:artifacts-neoforge-13.2.3.jar:data/artifacts/tags/item/artifacts.json#minus eternal_steak, everlasting_beef, umbrella, chorus_totem and crystal_heart

en_us.title: Something on your head
en_us.subtitle: Eight hats for one head.
text: [lead] One head slot, eight candidates: six hats and two face pieces.
Swap them by the job: Looting for a hunt, cheaper trades for a village run, air for a dive.
{page}
[li:artifacts:villager_hat] [item:artifacts:villager_hat|Villager Hat]: villagers charge less.
[li:artifacts:superstitious_hat] [item:artifacts:superstitious_hat|Superstitious Hat]: +[hl|1] Looting.
[li:artifacts:cowboy_hat] [item:artifacts:cowboy_hat|Cowboy Hat]: mounts [hl|40%] faster.
[li:artifacts:anglers_hat] [item:artifacts:anglers_hat|Angler's Hat]: +[hl|1] Luck of the Sea and +[hl|1] Lure.
[li:artifacts:plastic_drinking_hat] [item:artifacts:plastic_drinking_hat|Plastic] and [item:artifacts:novelty_drinking_hat|Novelty Drinking Hat]: drink and eat faster.
[item:artifacts:snorkel|Snorkel]: [hl|30] seconds of Water Breathing per dive.
[item:artifacts:night_vision_goggles|Night Vision Goggles]: a dim night vision, on and off with [key:artifacts.key.night_vision_goggles.toggle].

es_es.title: Algo en la cabeza
es_es.subtitle: Ocho sombreros para una cabeza.
text: [lead] Una ranura de cabeza, ocho candidatos: seis sombreros y dos piezas para la cara.
Cambialos según el laburo: Botín para cazar, precios bajos para ir a la aldea, aire para bucear.
{page}
[li:artifacts:villager_hat] [item:artifacts:villager_hat|Sombrero de Paja]: los aldeanos te cobran menos.
[li:artifacts:superstitious_hat] [item:artifacts:superstitious_hat|Sombrero de la Fortuna]: +[hl|1] de Botín.
[li:artifacts:cowboy_hat] [item:artifacts:cowboy_hat|Sombrero del Vaquero]: monturas [hl|40%] más rápidas.
[li:artifacts:anglers_hat] [item:artifacts:anglers_hat|Sombrero de Pescador]: +[hl|1] de Suerte marina y +[hl|1] de Atracción.
[li:artifacts:plastic_drinking_hat] Gorros para beber de [item:artifacts:plastic_drinking_hat|Plástico] y de [item:artifacts:novelty_drinking_hat|Tela]: tomás y comés más rápido.
[item:artifacts:snorkel|Gafas de Buceo]: [hl|30] segundos de Apnea por zambullida.
[item:artifacts:night_vision_goggles|Gafas de Visión Nocturna]: una visión nocturna tenue, que prendés y apagás con [key:artifacts.key.night_vision_goggles.toggle].

sources: jar:artifacts-neoforge-13.2.3.jar:data/curios/tags/item/head.json#head and face items share the head slot

en_us.title: Around your neck
en_us.subtitle: Nine to choose from, one neck to hang them on.
text: [lead] Luck, speed, breathing room or a counterattack: pick one.
The necklace slot holds scarves, pendants and charms.
{page}
[li:artifacts:lucky_scarf] [item:artifacts:lucky_scarf|Lucky Scarf]: +[hl|1] Fortune.
[li:artifacts:cross_necklace] [item:artifacts:cross_necklace|Cross Necklace]: a full second more of invulnerability after each hit.
[li:artifacts:panic_necklace] [item:artifacts:panic_necklace|Panic Necklace]: [hl|8] seconds of Speed when you're hurt.
[li:artifacts:thorn_pendant] [item:artifacts:thorn_pendant|Thorn], [item:artifacts:flame_pendant|Flame] and [item:artifacts:shock_pendant|Shock Pendant]: they strike back at attackers.
[li:artifacts:scarf_of_invisibility] [item:artifacts:scarf_of_invisibility|Scarf of Invisibility]: invisible.
[li:artifacts:charm_of_sinking] [item:artifacts:charm_of_sinking|Charm of Sinking]: walk the bottom and hold your breath longer.
[li:artifacts:charm_of_shrinking] [item:artifacts:charm_of_shrinking|Charm of Shrinking]: half your size.
[li] Each has its own on-off key, unbound at first: [key:artifacts.key.scarf_of_invisibility.toggle], [key:artifacts.key.charm_of_sinking.toggle], [key:artifacts.key.charm_of_shrinking.toggle].

es_es.title: Colgado del cuello
es_es.subtitle: Nueve para elegir, un solo cuello.
text: [lead] Suerte, velocidad, respiro o un contraataque: elegí uno.
La ranura de collar lleva bufandas, colgantes y amuletos.
{page}
[li:artifacts:lucky_scarf] [item:artifacts:lucky_scarf|Bufanda de la Suerte]: +[hl|1] de Fortuna.
[li:artifacts:cross_necklace] [item:artifacts:cross_necklace|Collar de Cruz]: un segundo más de invulnerabilidad después de cada golpe.
[li:artifacts:panic_necklace] [item:artifacts:panic_necklace|Collar de Pánico]: [hl|8] segundos de Velocidad cuando te lastiman.

[li:artifacts:thorn_pendant] [item:artifacts:thorn_pendant|Collar de Espinas], [item:artifacts:flame_pendant|de Fuego] y [item:artifacts:shock_pendant|de Rayos]: le devuelven el golpe a quien te ataca.
[li:artifacts:scarf_of_invisibility] [item:artifacts:scarf_of_invisibility|Bufanda de la Invisibilidad]: invisible.
[li:artifacts:charm_of_sinking] [item:artifacts:charm_of_sinking|Collar Acuático]: caminás por el fondo y aguantás más la respiración.
[li:artifacts:charm_of_shrinking] [item:artifacts:charm_of_shrinking|Collar del Enanismo]: la mitad de tu tamaño.

[li] Cada uno tiene su tecla para prenderlo y apagarlo, sin asignar al principio: [key:artifacts.key.scarf_of_invisibility.toggle], [key:artifacts.key.charm_of_sinking.toggle], [key:artifacts.key.charm_of_shrinking.toggle].

en_us.title: Hanging from your belt
en_us.subtitle: Where the lifesavers hang.
text: [lead] The belt is for staying alive.
A second jump, fire resistance when you burn, short bad effects, five extra hearts or a way out of a fatal hit.
{page}
[li:artifacts:cloud_in_a_bottle] [item:artifacts:cloud_in_a_bottle|Cloud in a Bottle]: double jump.
[li:artifacts:obsidian_skull] [item:artifacts:obsidian_skull|Obsidian Skull]: [hl|30] seconds of Fire Resistance after a burn, once a minute.
[li:artifacts:antidote_vessel] [item:artifacts:antidote_vessel|Antidote Vessel]: bad effects last [hl|5] seconds at most.
[li:artifacts:crystal_heart] [item:artifacts:crystal_heart|Crystal Heart]: +[hl|10] max health.
[li:artifacts:universal_attractor] [item:artifacts:universal_attractor|Universal Attractor]: pulls in nearby items, on and off with [key:artifacts.key.universal_attractor.toggle].
[li:artifacts:chorus_totem] [item:artifacts:chorus_totem|Chorus Totem]: once, a fatal hit teleports you away instead.
[li:artifacts:helium_flamingo] [item:artifacts:helium_flamingo|Helium Flamingo]: swim through the air.
[li:artifacts:warp_drive] [item:artifacts:warp_drive|Warp Drive]: ender pearls cost hunger, not pearls.

es_es.title: Colgando del cinturón
es_es.subtitle: Donde cuelgan los salvavidas.
text: [lead] El cinturón es para seguir con vida.
Un segundo salto, resistencia al fuego cuando te quemás, efectos malos cortos, cinco corazones extra o una salida ante un golpe fatal.
{page}
[li:artifacts:cloud_in_a_bottle] [item:artifacts:cloud_in_a_bottle|Nube Enbotellada]: doble salto.
[li:artifacts:obsidian_skull] [item:artifacts:obsidian_skull|Calavera de Obsidiana]: [hl|30] segundos de Cuerpo ignífugo después de quemarte, una vez por minuto.
[li:artifacts:antidote_vessel] [item:artifacts:antidote_vessel|Frasco del Antídoto]: los efectos malos duran [hl|5] segundos como mucho.
[li:artifacts:crystal_heart] [item:artifacts:crystal_heart|Corazón de Cristal]: +[hl|10] de vida máxima.
[li:artifacts:universal_attractor] [item:artifacts:universal_attractor|Imán Universal]: atrae los ítems cercanos, y se prende y apaga con [key:artifacts.key.universal_attractor.toggle].
[li:artifacts:chorus_totem] [item:artifacts:chorus_totem|Tótem de Coral]: una vez, un golpe fatal te teletransporta en lugar de matarte.
[li:artifacts:helium_flamingo] [item:artifacts:helium_flamingo|Flamenco de Helio]: nadás por el aire.
[li:artifacts:warp_drive] [item:artifacts:warp_drive|Propulsor de Movimiento]: las perlas de ender cuestan hambre y no perlas.

en_us.title: Two hands, two gloves
en_us.subtitle: Ten gloves, claws and rings; wear any two.
text: [lead] Two hands, so two of the ten work at once.
One for the fight and one for the mine, or both for the same job.
{page}
[li:artifacts:power_glove] [item:artifacts:power_glove|Power Glove]: +[hl|4] melee damage.
[li:artifacts:feral_claws] [item:artifacts:feral_claws|Feral Claws]: attack [hl|30%] faster.
[li:artifacts:vampiric_glove] [item:artifacts:vampiric_glove|Vampiric Glove]: heals a fifth of the melee damage you deal, up to [hl|6] a hit.
[li:artifacts:fire_gauntlet] [item:artifacts:fire_gauntlet|Fire Gauntlet]: sets targets on fire for [hl|8] seconds.
[li:artifacts:pocket_piston] [item:artifacts:pocket_piston|Pocket Piston]: more knockback.
[li:artifacts:withered_bracelet] [item:artifacts:withered_bracelet|Withered Bracelet]: [hl|30%] chance of Wither II.
[li:artifacts:digging_claws] [item:artifacts:digging_claws|Digging Claws]: dig [hl|30%] faster, and mine like a stone pickaxe bare-handed.
[li:artifacts:pickaxe_heater] [item:artifacts:pickaxe_heater|Pickaxe Heater]: smelts the ores you mine.
[li:artifacts:golden_hook] [item:artifacts:golden_hook|Golden Hook]: +[hl|50%] experience from mobs.
[li:artifacts:onion_ring] [item:artifacts:onion_ring|Onion Ring]: Haste II after you eat.

es_es.title: Dos manos, dos guantes
es_es.subtitle: Diez guantes, garras y anillos; usá dos.
text: [lead] Son dos manos: dos de los diez trabajan a la vez.
Uno para pelear y otro para minar, o los dos para lo mismo.
{page}
[li:artifacts:power_glove] [item:artifacts:power_glove|Guante del Poder]: +[hl|4] de daño cuerpo a cuerpo.
[li:artifacts:feral_claws] [item:artifacts:feral_claws|Garras de Rapidez]: atacás un [hl|30%] más rápido.
[li:artifacts:vampiric_glove] [item:artifacts:vampiric_glove|Guante Vampírico]: te cura un quinto del daño cuerpo a cuerpo que hacés, hasta [hl|6] por golpe.
[li:artifacts:fire_gauntlet] [item:artifacts:fire_gauntlet|Guante de Fuego]: prende fuego al objetivo [hl|8] segundos.
[li:artifacts:pocket_piston] [item:artifacts:pocket_piston|Pistón de Bolsillo]: más empuje.
[li:artifacts:withered_bracelet] [item:artifacts:withered_bracelet|Pulsera Descompuesta]: [hl|30%] de chance de Descomposición II.
[li:artifacts:digging_claws] [item:artifacts:digging_claws|Garras de Excavación]: picás un [hl|30%] más rápido y, a mano limpia, rompés como un pico de piedra.
[li:artifacts:pickaxe_heater] [item:artifacts:pickaxe_heater|Calentador de Picos]: funde los minerales que picás.
[li:artifacts:golden_hook] [item:artifacts:golden_hook|Garfio Dorado]: +[hl|50%] de experiencia de los mobs.
[li:artifacts:onion_ring] [item:artifacts:onion_ring|Anillo de Cebolla]: Prisa minera II después de comer.

en_us.title: Best foot forward
en_us.subtitle: A slot Artifacts brings along, just for shoes.
text: [lead] The feet slot belongs to Artifacts, and there's only one.
It isn't part of Curios: pick your shoes for the ground you're about to cross.
{page}
[li:artifacts:running_shoes] [item:artifacts:running_shoes|Running Shoes]: sprint [hl|40%] faster and step up blocks.
[li:artifacts:bunny_hoppers] [item:artifacts:bunny_hoppers|Bunny Hoppers]: jump [hl|40%] higher and fall [hl|10] blocks safely.
[li:artifacts:steadfast_spikes] [item:artifacts:steadfast_spikes|Steadfast Spikes]: no knockback, no slipping on ice.
[li:artifacts:kitty_slippers] [item:artifacts:kitty_slippers|Kitty Slippers]: creepers keep away and phantoms get hissed at.
[li:artifacts:aqua_dashers] [item:artifacts:aqua_dashers|Aqua-Dashers]: sprint over water.
[li:artifacts:flippers] [item:artifacts:flippers|Flippers]: swim [hl|70%] faster.
[li:artifacts:snowshoes] [item:artifacts:snowshoes|Snowshoes]: walk on powder snow.
[li:artifacts:strider_shoes] [item:artifacts:strider_shoes|Strider Shoes]: stand on lava while sneaking, and hot floors don't burn.
[li:artifacts:rooted_boots] [item:artifacts:rooted_boots|Rooted Boots]: grass refills your hunger.

es_es.title: Con el pie derecho
es_es.subtitle: Una ranura que trae Artifacts, sólo para calzado.
text: [lead] La ranura de pies es de Artifacts, y hay una sola.
No es de Curios: elegí el calzado según el terreno que vas a cruzar.
{page}
[li:artifacts:running_shoes] [item:artifacts:running_shoes|Zapatos de Deporte]: corrés un [hl|40%] más rápido y subís bloques sin saltar.
[li:artifacts:bunny_hoppers] [item:artifacts:bunny_hoppers|Botas de Conejo]: saltás un [hl|40%] más alto y caés [hl|10] bloques sin daño.
[li:artifacts:steadfast_spikes] [item:artifacts:steadfast_spikes|Garras Antiempuje]: nada de empuje ni resbalones en el hielo.
[li:artifacts:kitty_slippers] [item:artifacts:kitty_slippers|Zapatillas de Gatito]: los creepers se alejan y los fantasmas se ganan un bufido.
[li:artifacts:aqua_dashers] [item:artifacts:aqua_dashers|Botas de Agua]: corrés sobre el agua.
[li:artifacts:flippers] [item:artifacts:flippers|Aletas]: nadás un [hl|70%] más rápido.
[li:artifacts:snowshoes] [item:artifacts:snowshoes|Botas de Nieve]: caminás sobre la nieve polvo.
[li:artifacts:strider_shoes] [item:artifacts:strider_shoes|Zapatillas Ignífugas]: te parás en la lava agachado y los pisos calientes no queman.
[li:artifacts:rooted_boots] [item:artifacts:rooted_boots|Botas con Raíces]: el pasto te llena el hambre.

en_us.title: The full kit
en_us.subtitle: Six slots, one very well-dressed adventurer.
text: [lead] Six artifacts for six slots:
[li] Head
[li] Necklace
[li] Belt
[li] Both hands
[li] Feet
Two players in the same armor, two different ways of playing.

es_es.title: El equipo completo
es_es.subtitle: Seis ranuras y un aventurero muy bien vestido.
text: [lead] Seis artefactos para seis ranuras:
[li] Cabeza
[li] Collar
[li] Cinturón
[li] Las dos manos
[li] Los pies
Dos jugadores con la misma armadura, dos formas distintas de jugar.

en_us.title: One way out
en_us.subtitle: Chorus fruit, in totem form.
text: [lead] The [item:artifacts:chorus_totem|Chorus Totem] turns a fatal hit into a random teleport and gives back [hl|9] health, then breaks.
End city treasure and woodland mansions are where it turns up most.

es_es.title: Una sola salida
es_es.subtitle: Fruta coral, en formato tótem.
text: [lead] El [item:artifacts:chorus_totem|Tótem de Coral] convierte un golpe fatal en un teletransporte al azar y te devuelve [hl|9] de vida, y después se rompe.
Aparece más que nada en los tesoros de las ciudades del End y en las mansiones del bosque.

en_us.title: Swimming in the sky
en_us.subtitle: A pool float with ambitions.
text: [lead] The [item:artifacts:helium_flamingo|Helium Flamingo] lets you swim through the air.
[li:artifacts:helium_flamingo] Midair, press [key:key.sprint] (or [key:artifacts.key.helium_flamingo.activate], if you give it a key): [hl|8] seconds of swimming
[li] It recharges in [hl|15] seconds
It's among the rarest artifacts: try End cities, ancient cities and stronghold corridors.

es_es.title: Nadar en el cielo
es_es.subtitle: Un inflable de pileta con ambiciones.
text: [lead] El [item:artifacts:helium_flamingo|Flamenco de Helio] te deja nadar por el aire.
[li:artifacts:helium_flamingo] En el aire, apretá [key:key.sprint] (o [key:artifacts.key.helium_flamingo.activate], si le asignás una tecla): [hl|8] segundos de nado
[li] Se recarga en [hl|15] segundos
Es de los artefactos más raros: probá en ciudades del End, ciudades antiguas y pasillos de fortaleza.

sources: jar:artifacts-neoforge-13.2.3.jar:artifacts/registry/ModKeyMappings.class#getHeliumFlamingoKey falls back to keySprint while unbound

en_us.title: Pearls on credit
en_us.subtitle: Your stomach pays for the teleport.
text: [lead] Ender pearls that cost hunger instead of pearls.
With the [item:artifacts:warp_drive|Warp Drive] on your belt, pearls aren't used up: each throw costs [hl|2] hunger instead, and the landing doesn't hurt.

es_es.title: Perlas a crédito
es_es.subtitle: El estómago paga el teletransporte.
text: [lead] Perlas de ender que cuestan hambre y no perlas.
Con el [item:artifacts:warp_drive|Propulsor de Movimiento] en el cinturón, las perlas no se gastan: cada tiro cuesta [hl|2] de hambre y el aterrizaje no lastima.

en_us.title: Pendants that hit back
text: [lead] Three pendants that answer every hit.
[li:artifacts:thorn_pendant] [item:artifacts:thorn_pendant|Thorn Pendant]: hurts it back for [hl|2] to [hl|6], half the time
[li:artifacts:flame_pendant] [item:artifacts:flame_pendant|Flame Pendant]: sets it on fire [hl|40%] of the time and gives you Fire Resistance
[li:artifacts:shock_pendant] [item:artifacts:shock_pendant|Shock Pendant]: calls lightning [hl|25%] of the time, which can't hurt you

es_es.title: Collares que devuelven el golpe
text: [lead] Tres colgantes que responden a cada golpe.
[li:artifacts:thorn_pendant] [item:artifacts:thorn_pendant|Collar de Espinas]: le devuelve de [hl|2] a [hl|6] de daño, la mitad de las veces
[li:artifacts:flame_pendant] [item:artifacts:flame_pendant|Collar de Fuego]: lo prende fuego el [hl|40%] y te da Cuerpo ignífugo
[li:artifacts:shock_pendant] [item:artifacts:shock_pendant|Collar de Rayos]: le tira un rayo el [hl|25%], que a vos no te hace nada

en_us.title: Rain or shine
en_us.subtitle: An artifact for your hand, not a slot.
text: [lead] The [item:artifacts:umbrella|Umbrella] goes in no slot: hold it to fall slowly, or raise it like a shield.
Tanneries and buried treasure are where it turns up most.

es_es.title: Llueva o truene
es_es.subtitle: Un artefacto para la mano, no para una ranura.
text: [lead] El [item:artifacts:umbrella|Paraguas] no va en ninguna ranura: tenelo en la mano para caer despacio, o levantalo como un escudo.
Aparece más que nada en curtidurías y tesoros enterrados.

en_us.title: Kit: the miner
en_us.subtitle: Fortune first, furnace second.
text: [lead] [item:artifacts:digging_claws|Digging Claws] and [item:artifacts:pickaxe_heater|Pickaxe Heater] on your two hands, [item:artifacts:lucky_scarf|Lucky Scarf] on your neck.
Fortune multiplies the raw ore first and the heater smelts every piece, so the extra drops come out as ingots.

es_es.title: Kit: el minero
es_es.subtitle: Primero la fortuna, después el horno.
text: [lead] [item:artifacts:digging_claws|Garras de Excavación] y [item:artifacts:pickaxe_heater|Calentador de Picos] en las dos manos, [item:artifacts:lucky_scarf|Bufanda de la Suerte] en el cuello.
La Fortuna multiplica primero el mineral en bruto y el calentador funde cada pieza, así que lo extra sale en lingotes.

sources: jar:artifacts-neoforge-13.2.3.jar:artifacts/event/ArtifactHooks.class#applySmeltOresAbility: result count x drop count, c:ores and c:raw_materials

en_us.title: Kit: the diver
en_us.subtitle: Head, neck and feet, all underwater.
text: [lead] Three slots, one dive.
[li] [item:artifacts:snorkel|Snorkel] on your head
[li:artifacts:charm_of_sinking] [item:artifacts:charm_of_sinking|Charm of Sinking] on your neck
[li:artifacts:flippers] [item:artifacts:flippers|Flippers] on your feet
You breathe longer, walk the sea floor, and swim [hl|70%] faster when you switch the charm off.

es_es.title: Kit: el buzo
es_es.subtitle: Cabeza, cuello y pies, todo bajo el agua.
text: [lead] Tres ranuras, una zambullida.
[li] [item:artifacts:snorkel|Gafas de Buceo] en la cabeza
[li:artifacts:charm_of_sinking] [item:artifacts:charm_of_sinking|Collar Acuático] en el cuello
[li:artifacts:flippers] [item:artifacts:flippers|Aletas] en los pies
Respirás más, caminás por el fondo y nadás un [hl|70%] más rápido cuando apagás el collar.

en_us.title: Kit: the jumper
en_us.subtitle: What goes up comes down gently.
text: [lead] A double jump, a higher one and a soft landing.
[li:artifacts:cloud_in_a_bottle] [item:artifacts:cloud_in_a_bottle|Cloud in a Bottle] on the belt: a second jump
[li:artifacts:bunny_hoppers] [item:artifacts:bunny_hoppers|Bunny Hoppers] on your feet: [hl|40%] more jump
Together they let you fall [hl|13] more blocks unharmed.

es_es.title: Kit: el saltarín
es_es.subtitle: Todo lo que sube baja despacito.
text: [lead] Doble salto, más altura y aterrizaje suave.
[li:artifacts:cloud_in_a_bottle] [item:artifacts:cloud_in_a_bottle|Nube Enbotellada] en el cinturón: un segundo salto
[li:artifacts:bunny_hoppers] [item:artifacts:bunny_hoppers|Botas de Conejo] en los pies: [hl|40%] más de salto
Juntas te dejan caer [hl|13] bloques más sin daño.

en_us.title: Kit: the brawler
en_us.subtitle: Hit harder, heal more.
text: [lead] The glove that hits harder feeds the one that drinks.

A [item:artifacts:power_glove|Power Glove] on one hand and a [item:artifacts:vampiric_glove|Vampiric Glove] on the other: the extra [hl|4] damage raises what the vampire drinks, a fifth of every melee hit, up to [hl|6] health.

es_es.title: Kit: el peleador
es_es.subtitle: Pegá más fuerte, curate más.
text: [lead] El guante que pega más fuerte alimenta al que chupa.

Un [item:artifacts:power_glove|Guante del Poder] en una mano y un [item:artifacts:vampiric_glove|Guante Vampírico] en la otra: los [hl|4] de daño extra suben lo que chupa el vampírico, un quinto de cada golpe cuerpo a cuerpo, hasta [hl|6] de vida.

en_us.title: Kit: the Nether walker
en_us.subtitle: Lava is a floor if you sneak.
text: [lead] Shoes for the lava, a skull for the slip.
[li:artifacts:strider_shoes] [item:artifacts:strider_shoes|Strider Shoes] let you stand on lava while sneaking and ignore magma floors.
[li:artifacts:obsidian_skull] The [item:artifacts:obsidian_skull|Obsidian Skull] answers your first burn with [hl|30] seconds of Fire Resistance.
Slip once and there's time to get out.

es_es.title: Kit: el caminante del Nether
es_es.subtitle: La lava es piso si vas agachado.
text: [lead] Zapatillas para la lava, una calavera para el resbalón.
[li:artifacts:strider_shoes] Las [item:artifacts:strider_shoes|Zapatillas Ignífugas] te dejan pararte en la lava agachado e ignorar los bloques de magma.
[li:artifacts:obsidian_skull] La [item:artifacts:obsidian_skull|Calavera de Obsidiana] responde a tu primera quemadura con [hl|30] segundos de Cuerpo ignífugo.
Si te resbalás, hay tiempo para salir.

en_us.title: Kit: the hunter
en_us.subtitle: More loot, more levels, same mob.
text: [lead] Every kill pays out twice.

[item:artifacts:superstitious_hat|Superstitious Hat] on your head and [item:artifacts:golden_hook|Golden Hook] on a hand: every mob you kill drops as if your sword had one more level of Looting, and half again as much experience.

es_es.title: Kit: el cazador
es_es.subtitle: Más botín, más niveles, el mismo mob.
text: [lead] Cada muerte paga doble.

[item:artifacts:superstitious_hat|Sombrero de la Fortuna] en la cabeza y [item:artifacts:golden_hook|Garfio Dorado] en una mano: cada mob que matás suelta como si tu espada tuviera un nivel más de Botín, y la mitad más de experiencia.

en_us.title: Kit: the night owl
en_us.subtitle: For builders who forget to sleep.
text: [lead] Light in the dark and room to breathe.

[item:artifacts:night_vision_goggles|Night Vision Goggles] on your head and [item:artifacts:kitty_slippers|Kitty Slippers] on your feet: a little light in the dark, creepers that give you room, and phantoms hissed away before they dive.

es_es.title: Kit: el búho
es_es.subtitle: Para los que construyen y se olvidan de dormir.
text: [lead] Luz en la oscuridad y espacio para respirar.

[item:artifacts:night_vision_goggles|Gafas de Visión Nocturna] en la cabeza y [item:artifacts:kitty_slippers|Zapatillas de Gatito] en los pies: un poco de luz en la oscuridad, creepers que te dejan espacio y fantasmas espantados antes de que bajen en picada.

en_us.title: Wear one, show another
text: [tip] Every Artifacts slot has a cosmetic twin, shown with the cosmetics button of the Curios screen. Put the hat you like there and the useful one in the real slot: only the real one works.

es_es.title: Usá uno, mostrá otro
text: [tip] Cada ranura de Artifacts tiene su gemela cosmética, que aparece con el botón de cosméticos de la pantalla de Curios. Poné ahí el sombrero que te gusta y el útil en la ranura de verdad: sólo la de verdad funciona.

en_us.title: Mind the piglins
text: [tip] Piglins love gold, and that includes the [item:artifacts:golden_hook|Golden Hook], [item:artifacts:cross_necklace|Cross Necklace], [item:artifacts:antidote_vessel|Antidote Vessel] and [item:artifacts:universal_attractor|Universal Attractor]: drop one near them and they'll grab it.

es_es.title: Ojo con los piglins
text: [tip] Los piglins aman el oro, y eso incluye el [item:artifacts:golden_hook|Garfio Dorado], el [item:artifacts:cross_necklace|Collar de Cruz], el [item:artifacts:antidote_vessel|Frasco del Antídoto] y el [item:artifacts:universal_attractor|Imán Universal]: si se te cae uno cerca, lo agarran.

en_us.title: Adventurous Eater
en_us.subtitle: It was an Onion Ring. It was right there.
text: [lead] You ate the [item:artifacts:onion_ring|Onion Ring].
It fills [hl|2] hunger and it's gone for good, and the Haste II it gave you after every meal went with it.

es_es.title: Comedor aventurero
es_es.subtitle: Era un Anillo de Cebolla. Estaba ahí.
text: [lead] Te comiste el [item:artifacts:onion_ring|Anillo de Cebolla].
Llena [hl|2] de hambre y se va para siempre, y con él se fue la Prisa minera II que te daba después de cada comida.

en_us.title: Comic relief
en_us.subtitle: Every sculk sensor in range heard that.
text: [lead] The [item:artifacts:whoopee_cushion|Whoopee Cushion] fits any slot and does what you'd expect [hl|12%] of the times you sneak or double jump.
Sculk sensors hear it. So does the Warden.

es_es.title: Un clásico del recreo
es_es.subtitle: Todo sensor de sculk cercano escuchó eso.
text: [lead] El [item:artifacts:whoopee_cushion|Cojín de Pedos] entra en cualquier ranura y hace lo que imaginás el [hl|12%] de las veces que te agachás o hacés doble salto.
Los sensores de sculk lo escuchan. El Warden también.

sources: jar:curios-neoforge-9.5.1+1.21.1.jar:top/theillusivec4/curios/mixin/CuriosImplMixinHooks.class#the curio slot tag fits every slot

en_us.title: Light the cabinet lamp
en_us.subtitle: Dust looks better in warm light.
text: [lead] Somebody has to see what all this is worth.
No reward: warm light on every shelf, and a few motes of dust.

es_es.title: Prendé la lámpara de la vitrina
es_es.subtitle: El polvo queda mejor con luz cálida.
text: [lead] Alguien tiene que ver cuánto vale todo esto.
Sin premio: luz cálida en cada estante y algunas motas de polvo.

en_us.title: Polish the glass
en_us.subtitle: Fingerprints are part of the collection.
text: [lead] A cabinet is only as good as its glass.
No reward: a few streaks of shine and some glitter.

es_es.title: Lustrá el vidrio
es_es.subtitle: Las huellas también son parte de la colección.
text: [lead] Una vitrina vale lo que vale su vidrio.
Sin premio: unos reflejos y un poco de brillo.
